note: Bitcoin mainnet genesis. natural_block_hash is SHA-256d(header_hex), byte 0 first. display_block_hash is that digest reversed: display[i] = natural[31 - i]. SPEC §9 requires this display spelling for block_hash on P_g, P_b, and claimed_block. stored_hash stays the natural spelling. This file is not part of the regenerated spec/conformance/v2.0 pack. A hike that carries these bytes uses inclusion height 5 so the path sits in the quiet object's anchor window. That hike height is not bitcoin_height.
